scenes.title: Counts on construction drawings, with the evidence you can click
lines: Local readers answer what the drawing itself can prove.
scenes.foot: Junction 2026 · Stoa, Verda and NVIDIA challenges
scenes.narration: Planproof answers quantity questions about construction drawings. Every count links to the marks on the drawing that support it.
This floor plan was held back for the test. The new reader reads windows and doors a second time, at a scale set by the drawing's own doors. It marks all 18 windows. The previous reader counted 15.
Questions the old reader had to defer now get an answer from the room map of the same detector. Here it counts 3 storeys, one box for each.
A zero is an answer too. For saunas, the reader shows the rooms it examined before it says none.

scenes.title: Exact answers, offline, on drawings held back from development
scenes.foot: Baseline sealed before any tuning · one scoring · protocol in docs/scan-next-protocol.md
scenes.narration: On 72 drawings held back from development, with 608 questions, exact answers rose from 189 to 325 with no hosted model at all. 70 percent of the answers it gives are exact, up from 57.

scenes.kicker: On NVIDIA hardware · Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
scenes.title: Local evidence first, NVIDIA for the rest

metrics.label: Planproof readers with Nemotron behind them

scenes.narration: What the local readers cannot prove goes to Nemotron on NVIDIA's endpoint. Nemotron alone gets 247 of the 608 questions exactly right. With Planproof's readers in front, and Nemotron reasoning over small shower symbols, the same endpoint reaches 405, with 143 calls instead of 608.

Showers have no local reader. Asked live in the app, Nemotron reasons over the drawing on NVIDIA's endpoint and marks both showers, which is the right count. The source line names the model that answered.
